components: Index Terms-remote sensing, multispectral object detection, rotation-equivariant neural networks, spectral order modeling, spatial-spectral feature learning I.
I NTRODUCTION Multispectral images (MSIs) capture scene reflectance across multiple spectral bands, revealing material-dependent spectral signatures beyond RGB imagery [1].
Multispectral object detection (MOD) is a fundamental task for remote sensing scene understanding, with applications in traffic monitoring, urban management, and public safety [2], [3].

deploymentClaims: Peak memory denotes the host process's maximum resident set size, average board power is measured at the 12 V DC input, and energy per image is the product of mean latency and average power.

Across rotationgroup variants, latency and peak memory grow with group order: from C1 to C8 , latency rises from 28.2 to 181.0 ms, throughput falls from 35.5 to 5.5 FPS, and peak memory increases from 82 to 595 MiB.
